title: SDGym
summary: SDGym is MIT DAI Lab's benchmarking framework for synthetic data generators, evaluating models built on SDV, SDMetrics, and CTGAN across single-table, multi-table, and time-series datasets. This repository vendors in-tree copies of the ctgan, sdv, and sdmetrics packages and extends the vendored ctgan source by adding a new differentially-private dpCTGANSynthesizer class alongside the standard CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer.
evidence: ctgan/__init__.py:9-11 imports CTGANSynthesizer, dpCTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer from the vendored ctgan package
needs: No call site for dpCTGANSynthesizer or the other vendored synthesizers was observed in the evidence; unclear if the fork is actually run/tested beyond the vendored bundle.
